title: Harvard LEAD Fellowship for Promoting Women in Global Health
about: Fellowship from September 1, 2027 to August 31, 2028 for global health leaders from low- and middle-income countries, including a six-week in-person experience in Cambridge, MA, in spring 2028.
requirements: Full-time work in global health with at least 10 years of professional experience beyond education
From a low- or middle-income country
Able to obtain a J-1 visa

upskill.name: Leading AI Transformation
why: "Substantial leadership experience" (qualification) → "Identify sources of organizational resistance and develop leadership approaches that encourage experimentation, trust, adoption, and responsible use across teams."
"leadership" (skill) → "Develop a structured transformation roadmap that moves the organization from isolated AI experiments toward scalable and organization-wide adoption."
